channel.title: Uttarakhand: CAP Disaster Alert Feeds
channel.description: CAP Integrated Alert System Warning Updates

item.title: Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and gusty wind (30-40 kmph) likely to occur is likely to occur at isolated places over Almora, Bageshwar, Chamoli, Champawat, Dehradun, Nainital, Pauri Garhwal, Pithoragarh, Rudraprayag, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarkashi in next 24 hours.
item.author: controlroom@ndma.gov.in (IMD Dehradun)
